title: Kubescape fleet report
description: The combined report written by --fleet-report. The format may still change while fleet scanning is in alpha, and later releases may add fields and status or exclusion reason values. See docs/fleet-scanning.md for how to handle them.

clusters.description: One entry per requested context, including the ones that could not be scanned.

FleetMetadata.description: The run that produced the report.

contexts.description: The contexts that were requested, in the order given.

clusterID.description: Identifies the cluster across the report. Currently the context name.

context.description: The kubeconfig context the scan ran against.

error.description: The failure behind a status other than scanned.

complianceScore.description: Absent when the cluster was not measured, which is not the same as 0.

coverage.description: How complete the scan was. Its contents are not covered by this schema.

duration.description: How long the cluster took, in Go duration format, across every attempt and wait.

attempts.description: How many times the cluster was scanned. Absent when the scan never started.

report.description: The cluster's own report without its raw resources, present when it was scanned. Its contents are not covered by this schema.

ComplianceRollup.description: The fleet score and where it came from.

complianceScore.description: The mean across the clusters that counted. Absent when none did.

minCoverage.description: The coverage floor that was applied. 0 means none.

FrameworkRollup.description: One framework's score across the fleet.

complianceScore.description: Absent when no cluster scored this framework.

clustersReporting.description: Contributing clusters that ran the framework, including vacuous ones.

vacuousIn.description: Clusters where the framework scored 100% only because every control in it was irrelevant.

ExcludedCluster.description: One cluster left out of the fleet score.

complianceScore.description: The score that was not counted. Set only for lowCoverage.

FleetControlMatrix.description: Every control a scanned cluster reported, and what each of those clusters found.

byCluster.description: Keyed by clusterID. A cluster missing here contributed no data for this control.

ControlStatusCell.description: One control's outcome in one cluster.

complianceScore.description: -1 when the control carries no score.

FleetDivergence.description: The controls the clusters do not agree on.

referenceUnavailable.description: A reference cluster was requested but contributed nothing to the control matrix.

ControlDivergence.description: One control the clusters disagree on, and which clusters landed where.

postureDiverges.description: One cluster passed and another failed.

coverageGap.description: One cluster could not evaluate the control while another produced an outcome.
